title: The Social Network Era
tagline: Smartphones, status updates and a new tablet on the couch.

locale.persona: a young professional in a U.S. city

morningRoutine.detail: Scroll social media before getting up. A new photo app, Instagram, launched for the iPhone in October 2010.
Location apps let you "check in" at the coffee shop.

futureVisions.whoSaidIt: Google, whose self-driving car project was revealed on October 9, 2010
futureVisions.note: Robotaxis now carry paying passengers in 10 U.S. metro areas, about 500,000 rides a week by June 2026, but most cars are still driven by people.

futureVisions.prediction: 3D television is the next big thing for the living room.
futureVisions.whoSaidIt: Major TV manufacturers, which launched full lines of 3D sets after the January 2010 Consumer Electronics Show
futureVisions.note: Broadcasters dropped 3D channels by 2013 and most manufacturers had stopped making 3D sets by 2017.

futureVisions.prediction: PCs will be like trucks: still around and still valuable, but used by only one out of a few people, as tablets and phones take over everyday computing.
futureVisions.whoSaidIt: Steve Jobs, interview at the D8 conference, June 2010
futureVisions.note: PC sales declined through the 2010s in favour of phones and tablets, but desktop and laptop PCs kept their own uses.
